description: Propose removing ALL speaker enrollments with {}. To recover an incompatible/corrupt UID store, close speech and supply recovery with the exact hashes (or absent) from speaker.list.recovery: always the enrollment and captures digests, plus the speaker registry digest exactly when speaker.list.recovery reports one. After operator confirmation, recovery archives every named original file in private content-addressed storage, clears pending recordings, creates an empty profile for the current model and, when named, an empty speaker registry. This is not embedding conversion. Changed bytes require a fresh confirmation. No caller storage path or confirmation stamp.

session_id.description: Optional session consistency check from speaker.list. Omit when managing enrollment without an open speech session.

recovery.description: Optional operator-confirmed recovery of incompatible or corrupt UID storage. Copy every exact digest from speaker.list.recovery. Requires a closed speech session; original files are archived before an empty current-model profile is created. Omit for normal reset.

enrollment_sha256.description: Copy speaker.list.recovery.enrollment_sha256 exactly: the observed enrollment file SHA-256, or absent only when that observation reports no file.

captures_sha256.description: Copy speaker.list.recovery.captures_sha256 exactly: the observed captures file SHA-256, or absent only when that observation reports no file.

speaker_registry_sha256.description: Copy speaker.list.recovery.speaker_registry_sha256 exactly when that observation reports it, and omit it otherwise: the observed incompatible or corrupt speaker registry file SHA-256. Its UUIDs, labels and voiceprints are archived, not converted.
